Priya (Solutions): Quick kickoff for Concrete POC migrating from Blockwell's API. Ana is on the thread. Goal: confirm mapping, security Qs, pricing deltas, and any enterprise blockers.

Ana (Concrete): Thanks — we want parity with existing flows. Biggest pain points so far: session continuity, canonical response IDs, and rate-limit handling.

Devon (Eng): Noted. Can you paste an example request/response from Blockwell? small sample will help us map shapes.

Ana (Concrete): Sure — example:

```
POST /v1/complete
{ "prompt": "Summarize...", "session_id": "s-123" }

200 OK
{ "id": "abc123", "text": "...", "finish_reason": "stop" }
```

Priya (Solutions): Our API has `conversation_id` + token billing per-token. We'll need to match `session_id` semantics and ensure `id` mapping to our request_id.

Devon (Eng): Quick mapping proposal (WIP):
- Blockwell `session_id` -> Redwood `conversation_id`
- Blockwell `id` -> Redwood `response_id`
- `finish_reason` values differ (Blockwell uses "stop", "length", Redwood uses "complete", "truncated")

Mapping snippet:

```
// translation layer pseudocode
mapped = {
  "conversation_id": incoming.session_id,
  "response_id": incoming.id,
  "finish_reason": incoming.finish_reason == "stop" ? "complete" : incoming.finish_reason
}
```

Ben (Sales): Pricing note: Blockwell bills at 2.4x our standard tokens for their smaller model; if Concrete keeps same call pattern, monthly cost delta estimate is ~+18%. We can offer a presales credit to cover first month while they validate.

Ana (Concrete): Good to know. Also, our security team asked about KMS and token lifecycle — can you confirm we can integrate with our Azure Key Vault and SSO?

Sara (Security): We can support Azure Key Vault for model keys and Redwood Private supports SSO via SAML. Need to capture their SCQ (security questionnaire) answers. @Ana please share the questionnaire PDF.

Ana (Concrete): Uploaded in private link: https://concrete.example.com/secure/presales/scq.pdf

Devon (Eng): I'll review SCQ items relevant to network egress, data residency, and audit logs. Quick checklist:
- KMS integration: yes (Azure + AWS KMS)
- VPC peering: yes for Private
- Audit logs retention: configurable to 1y
- Model caching: note that our KV cache may change tokenization behavior slightly; need to flag to eval team

Priya (Solutions): Action items:
1) Devon: produce a short adapter shim PR to map session/ids and normalize finish_reason (target EOW).
2) Sara: prefill SCQ answers and security cover note (48h).
3) Ben: create pricing credit offer and update SOW draft.
4) Ana: share any additional failure modes (timeouts, long streaming sessions).

Devon (Eng): Will open a branch `concrete/adapter-shim` and post link here once ready.

infra-bot: dev environment `concrete-poc` provisioned on staging-2 (IP 10.4.8.12). Credentials shared via 1Password.

Ana (Concrete): Confirmed I have creds. Will run a few smoke calls tomorrow and report differences.

Priya (Solutions): Great. If we see response drift during smoke tests, we may suggest a small prompt calibration suite (10 canonical prompts) — that'll let us quantify parity and set acceptance criteria.

Ben (Sales): I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Legal to align SOW + credit terms. Proposed time: Thu 10am PT.

Ana (Concrete): Thu 10am PT works.

Priya (Solutions): Thanks everyone. I'll keep the thread updated. :thumbsup:
